name: Cloud Detection
description: Claude Code skills for cloud threat detection, shadow-AI discovery, later-moment (post-incident) investigation, shared collection, and reporting across AWS, Git, and Google Workspace.

plugins.name: cloud-detection
plugins.description: Continuous cloud threat detection and posture: AWS CloudTrail business baselines and portable detection specs, plus shadow-AI detection across AWS VPC Flow Logs, Git repositories, and Google Workspace.

plugins.name: cloud-chaining
plugins.description: Proactive attack-path chaining across an AWS estate: collect the exposure/identity/crown-jewel graph, merge it, enumerate scored kill chains from an internet foothold or a single stolen credential to crown jewels, correlate live GuardDuty threats, and package red-team reports. Extensible misconfiguration->primitive->MITRE knowledge base.

plugins.name: cloud-investigation
plugins.description: Later-moment (post-incident) examination: AWS CloudTrail raw-evidence packaging and business-context triage. Home for the broader AWS incident-response and forensics suite.

plugins.name: cloud-collection
plugins.description: Shared collectors and exporters that feed detection and investigation: AWS CloudTrail lookup collection and normalization, and Google Workspace admin-report export.

plugins.name: cloud-reporting
plugins.description: Cross-cutting report packagers that turn CloudTrail and shadow-AI findings into Markdown, CSV, and JSON reporting artifacts for MDR and security review.
